content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy positions itself as a simple tool for selling digital products, but it excludes creators in many countries. Stripe, available in only 46 of 195 countries, limits access even further, forcing creators to rely on unstable alternatives. PayPal, while globally recognized, can suspend accounts and hold funds indefinitely, creating uncertainty. In contrast, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-explained-digital-creators-2|Sovereign Commerce]] commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack empowers creators with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-2|COREMERCH guide to complete]] control over their online storefronts, eliminating reliance on restrictive platforms and providing a permanent structural alternative.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Lemon Squeezy and PayPal both enforce geographic restrictions that leave many creators in the lurch. When creators in restricted countries attempt to use these platforms, they are met with barriers that culminate in denied access or suspended accounts. COREMERCH’s infrastructure, however, is designed for true sovereignty, allowing creators in any country to set up a fully operational online store without the fear of being locked out or suspended. This infrastructure is built to withstand the limitations imposed by traditional platforms, ensuring that creators can thrive regardless of their location.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing through platforms like PayPal can take days, with fees that accumulate quickly, often leading to hidden costs. Stripe's transaction fees add up, especially for creators selling lower-priced products. In contrast, COREMERCH offers NOWPayments, which processes payments almost instantaneously, with a minimal fee of 0.5%. The overall cost for creators using a sovereign commerce infrastructure remains transparent and manageable, allowing them to retain more of their earnings while enjoying efficient payment processing.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators without geographic restrictions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With platforms like Lemon Squeezy and PayPal, creators often find themselves at the mercy of terms and conditions that can change overnight, jeopardizing their ownership of content and customer data. These platforms control the user experience and can restrict access to critical functions. In contrast, with COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, creators retain full ownership of their digital assets and customer data, ensuring autonomy. This stack automates payment processing and product delivery, providing a seamless experience that allows creators to focus on their work rather than platform limitations.

If you need a quick and efficient setup, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a ready-to-go solution with everything you need for payment processing, product loading, and secure delivery. For those looking for extensive documentation and a do-it-yourself approach, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) offers complete guidance. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
